market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower. Oil-driven energy strength offsets bank and iron ore weakness. Hormuz escalation and US midterms add volatility. RBA on hold but inflation risk from oil keeps rate-cut expectations muted. AUD/USD pressured by global risk-off.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift away from iron ore toward gold, uranium, and energy. Property credit cycle remains the key domestic overhang. If Hormuz de-escalates, oil normalises and energy premium fades. US policy uncertainty caps global equity multiples. Australian living standards under pressure constrain consumer recovery.
